2.content: When rating a move, compute the change in Manhattan distance to the goal (Δd). Add a positive bonus proportional to -Δd when the move reduces distance (Δd < 0). Conversely, apply a strong negative penalty proportional to +Δd when the move increases distance (Δd > 0). The magnitude of the distance increase penalty should exceed any hazard penalty, ensuring moves that backtrack are rated lower than safe moves that maintain distance.

6.content: When rating a move, add a penalty proportional to the number of hole cells adjacent (Manhattan distance 1) to the resulting state. If the move reduces Manhattan distance to the goal by at least 2, halve the penalty; otherwise apply the full penalty. Do not waive the penalty entirely, even for strong progress moves.
